Hobson’s Choice
Dec 2025 • Solo
Not sure it’s the timing of my visit but there was only Squid Noodle in soup available even though the menu clearly shows 4 different variations of noodles. That left me with no choice but to have whatever they had available at the time. Don’t get me wrong, the flavor of the broth is good, the squid was fresh and vermicelli tasted good. Just wished I had shrimp along with my vermicelli. I also ordered an iced Orange Honey beverage, which was good and refreshing. The staff spoke little to no English but since there was only one kind of vermicelli available, that wasn’t a problem. I am giving only an average rating only because of the lack of choice of vermicelli.

Suspiciously good reviews from one-time reviewers
Oct 2019
Firstly, all this place does for 'main' meals is squid or seafood soup, so if like me, you go in there hungry, you might still bee wanting more food after that. It's a place for a snack and not a main meal. Secondly, I found the food fine; nothing that special to rave about but certainly acceptable. Third, what's going on with all these glowing reviews from JCL contributors? Looks irregular to put it politely, and if I can see that, can't TA?
